articleTitle: Diversity in nature and technology — Tool for increase the reliability of systems
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: On the basis of a comparative analysis an analogy can be made between the diversity of technology and the diversity of nature. As a result of this analysis, philosophical summaries have been made. The role of the diversity in the technique for complex achievement of better indicators is considered: reliability, security, detection, identification, which ensure a higher probability of system survival (survivability). Suggestions for further scientific developments in the field of research and application of the diversity of technology are given.

articleTitle: Experimental design of stand-alone field oriented control for WECS in variable speed DFIG-based on hysteresis current controller
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the experimental design of a stand-alone field-oriented control (FOC) for wind turbine based on a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG). The control law is synthesized using a hybrid FOC-Hysteresis current controller (HCC) in Rotor side converter (RSC) and the stator is connected to the resistive load via rectifier (nonlinear load). The regulation is achieved below the synchronous speed (Hypo-synchronous mode). The implementation is realized using dSPACE1104 single board control and acquisition interface. The obtained results of the proposed control present high performance in steady and transient states.

articleTitle: Losses and temperature rise within power transformers subjected to distorted currents
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The currently high energy efficiency demands and control requirements impose an extensive usage of power electronic devices and circuits in both domestic and industrial applications. These intrinsic nonlinear loads generate prominent level distortion of the electric current waveforms, which lead to additional losses and thermal stress within the power supply distribution system. Thus, due to the supplementary harmonic losses, the power transformer, experience an increase of its hot-spot temperature that may cause the machine insulation failure and ultimately the transformer lifetime expectancy reduction. In order to overcome these undesirable consequences, the reduction of the apparent power rating of the transformer (derating) is commonly adopted. This paper quantitatively investigates the nonsinusoidal steady state of the transformer by evaluating the losses distribution within the machine, its hot-spot temperature rise and the corresponding transformer loss of life. The computation procedure is exemplified on a 250 kVA liquid filled three-phase power distribution transformer that supplies both linear and nonlinear industrial loads.

articleTitle: Cogging torque effect on motor start-up in a sensorless motor drive for permanent magnet synchronous motors
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper deals with issues created by the cogging torque exhibited in permanent magnet synchronous motors in a motor drive with field oriented control. Experimental results are shown for both the start-up procedure and the steady-state operation of the used motor. The static and cogging torque are also measured at low speed to optimize the parameters of the start-up algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and comparison of outer rotor bonded magnets Halbach motor with different topologies
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The outer rotor Halbach cylinder motor is designed for hybrid electric vehicle application. The Halbach cylinder is made of bonded magnet and hence the design presented is high torque density motor with low remanence magnet. Different slots poles combinations for double layer tooth coil winding is also evaluated to find the best combination. The Halbach cylinder motor is also compared with different other motor topologies. The outer rotor Halbach motor has the highest torque compared to other topologies over the whole speed range. Variations of inductance and flux linkage of different topologies are also studied and are presented in the article.

articleTitle: Design & comparison of a conventional and permanent magnet based claw-pole machine for automotive application
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the design and performance comparison of a conventional claw-pole machine with a permanent magnet based claw-pole machine for automotive application. The magnets are placed in the inter-claw region to decrease the leakage flux and to supply increased magnetic flux in the machine. It has been observed that with the addition of permanent magnets weighing only a few grams, there is a significant increment of more than 22% in output power of the machine. The geometric dimensions of magnets were also varied to verify their effects on performance and it has been observed that with the increase in magnet weight there is a non-linear increment in torque of the machine.

articleTitle: Challenges for Bulgarian Industrial Small and Medium sized Enterprises to manage change effectively
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Bulgarian Industrial Small and Medium Sized Enterprises (SMEs) have to be really innovative and flexible in order not only to survive at the market, but to develop competitive advantages. Decisions today are not necessary to be the right for tomorrow, but still the management should try to react proactively to this uncertain environment. Change management is difficult and complex process that becomes even more complicated when we consider change for industrial enterprises in terms of financial and human dimensions. In order to decrease uncertainty in the process of planning and implementation change, we elaborate the methods for risk analysis and on this base - to help managers to eliminate in some degree the uncertainty.

articleTitle: Dynamic study of thermal characteristics of linear induction motors
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Nowadays, the transport on a magnetic cushion meets more often. This makes it important to study and design this type of transport. The most important criterion of public transport is reliability. Therefore, in this article is considered the thermal characteristics of a linear induction machine under intensive track operation. Thermal characteristics are calculated using the method of detailed equivalent heat circuit. A brief analysis of the possibility of operation in different operating modes is given.

articleTitle: Tilos, the first autonomous renewable green island in Mediterranean: A Horizon 2020 project
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the project Tilos consisting in maximizing the use of clean (renewable) energy sources for covering the electricity needs of the Tilos island in Greece. The objectives of this Horizon 2020 project are presented and a synthesis of the realized work two years after the beginning of the project is shown.

articleTitle: Comparative study of electric car traction motors
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The main design and technology features of different traction motors in today's produced battery electric vehicles are considered. The advantages and the arguments for choice of certain principal solutions and concepts by the electric car drive are analyzed. In the paper the traction motor design is researched by means of finite element simulations and the aim is to reveal some substantive aspects of the electromagnetic energy conversion.

Author Keywords: rare earth permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: Development of an algorithm for modal control of SISO linear time-invariant discrete systems
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper an algorithm for modal control of linear time-invariant (LTI) discrete system is proposed to improve the quality of the processes and achieve the desired stability degree of the system. For this purpose the suggested algorithm is calculating the feedback state vector for a single-input single-output (SISO) system so that the closed loop poles to be distributed into a predefined sector on the positive axis. As the calculated control signal delivered by the developed algorithm is a scalar variable it could be given the following name: scalar modal control (SMC) algorithm.

articleTitle: Modelling of current sensor based on hall effect
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article, computer models for Hall effect-based current sensors are developed. The main objective is to obtain models, with which the output characteristics of such sensors is studied, as well as to determine various factors that affect their sensitivity.

articleTitle: The indicators system for the short circuit currents levels assessment in the power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Currently there is a problem of insufficient information content and clarity of the data obtained as a result of short-circuit currents calculation in a power system that negatively affects efficiency of decision-making at power systems operation and development planning. This paper offers the methodology assuming the choice of substations-indicators of short-circuit currents levels on the basis of evaluation system for amount of change of the current and perspective levels of short-circuit currents. This approach has been applied to an assessment of short-circuit currents levels in a regional power system. On the basis of the obtained data technical requirements on the switching devices breaking capacity in the existing substations of considered energy area have been formulated.

articleTitle: Application of infrared thermography technique in transformers maintenance in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Reliable and accurate information about the condition of electrical equipment, obtained by thermographic surveys determines their wide use in the maintenance of distribution networks. Well maintained electrical equipment, especially transformers, is one of the main factors for ensuring uninterrupted power supply to the end users. The standard methods for faults diagnosis in most cases require the supply voltage to be switched off. This may lead to financial losses and dissatisfied customers. The biggest advantage of the testing of transformers with thermographic camera is monitoring of each item, regardless of its location within the framework of its operation. Infrared thermography can pinpoint defects that have already occurred and help diagnose others in their initial phase, thus preventing expensive repairs, serious energy losses, short circuits and fires. The aim of this paper is to present a brief theoretical introduction of the infrared thermography technique, an overview of the classification of thermal abnormalities, results, and their analysis, from study of several transformer stations on the premises of a Bulgarian utility company.

articleTitle: Harmonic analysis of the magnetic field of a coaxial magnetic gear
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper two constructions of a coaxial magnetic gear (CMG) have been investigated. A 2D time dependent Finite Element Method (FEM) models of the two constructions have been implemented. A harmonic analysis of the gears' magnetic fields and output dynamic torques are performed. The FEM modelling is carried out by ANSYS Maxwell software. The harmonic analysis is made by Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) method in MATLAB. Results for the magnetic flux density and the torque dynamic spectrum distributions are obtained.

articleTitle: A real time street lighting control system
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article elaborates the design and construction of automatic light control system. The developed electronic system eliminates the disadvantages of the existing systems by taking date and time from the GPS, as it also gives information about the position of the system. Based on the results the microcontroller calculates and automatically detects geographical area and retrieve relevant data for sunrise and sunset in the area, respectively ensures very precise ON/OFF mode of the lighting system. It doesn't need operator maintenance and initial installation setup. The developed electronic device increases bulb life in result of the dimming effect. On the other hand this decrease of the illumination leads to reduce in the energy consumption.

articleTitle: Algorithm for selection of passive harmonics filters
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The use of power resonant filters (PRF or only filters) is one of the ways to reduce the distribution and impact of harmonics of current and voltage in power supply systems of industrial plants. The design of the filters is strictly individual and complex task for any power supply system (PSS). In this paper an algorithm has been developed that can be followed in the selection of the filters, taking into account the specifics of each PSS and using its adequate software model. Example and results of the algorithm implementation for a specific PSS have been shown. Methodical peculiarities in the algorithm implementation for any other power supply system have been described.

articleTitle: Design considerations of ZVS converter for charging of energy storage elements
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a converter for charging and equalizing voltages across energy storage elements (ESE) - superconductors or rechargeable batteries, which are connected in series. The converter operates in soft switching mode: ZVS conditions are provided. The charged elements are galvanically separated from the main by high frequency transformers. Transformers and rectifiers can be made constructively as separate modules for each charged element. The number of modules depends on the number of items loaded. The paper presents also basic relations for dimensioning the magnetic components of the scheme and calculated and compared example designs.

articleTitle: Small wind generator system with non-inverting buck-boost converter and battery storage
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A small wind generator system with a claw-pole permanent magnet synchronous generator and a non-inverting buck-boost converter has been modelled in this study. The system uses a battery as a storage device and for stabilization of the output voltage. The system was simulated with four different battery voltages and changing wind speed. The results from the study provide a basis for optimal choice of electrical generator, battery voltage and capacity and give possibility for further development.

articleTitle: Electrical energy wireless transfert: Application to electric roads
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper focuses on wireless energy transfer mechanisms applied to urban electric vehicles. It describes the using conditions of a particular transformer without ferromagnetic core, supplied by a resonant inverter and loaded by mobile sources (catenaries with magnetic induction to power electric vehicles). The system consists of unconventional transformers with large air-gaps and a generator who supplies the transformer. The paper describes the theoretical model used for the numerical simulation (magnetic circuit, power converter, loads), and the measurements provided by our experimental platform (Tesla lab.). The transformer is supplied by a half-bridge series resonant converter. The transformer secondary coil is mobile compared to the primary, which is fixed on the road. This system is found in many industrial applications such as light automatic vehicles, tramways, etc. In this work we will show that the performance of a transformer without magnetic circuit can be equivalent to a standard transformer.

articleTitle: Modelling of an off-grid photovoltaic power supplying system for telecommunication equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the following paperwork a photovoltaic power supplying system for telecommunication equipment has been modelled. The power supplied equipment can be radio communication equipment, active equipment for optic networks and other. The model is developed in LabView. The chosen capacities of the energy storage elements (ESE) can be determined by using the developed model. The model can be used to determine if the capacity of the ESE is enough or not.

articleTitle: The weather impact on the overhead line losses
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Based on statistical estimations of historical data, in this paper is reported the weather condition impact on the transmission losses of the existing overhead interconnector between Bulgaria and Greece, due to the resistance variation and the corona losses, including the operated voltage level.

articleTitle: Modelling of single transistor parallel ZVS DC-DC converter
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In present work is carried out modelling of single transistor parallel ZVS DC-DC converter. Main advantage of power circuit is direct work in steady mode. Thus, that allows avoiding a starting procedure and guarantees reliable operation in significant major change in load occur. The model is realised with Matlab. Computer simulations and experiments in lab model are performed by which the model is confirmed. Version of controlling the converter is proposed, also practically realised.

articleTitle: Ferroresonance modes determination of single-phase toroidal transformers
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The actual high incidence of the low-loss power transformers in the modern electric and electronic installations, increase the risk of the ferroresonance occurrence. This could be commonly triggered by a capacitive switching of the transformers. Consequently, significant overvoltages and overcurents are experienced by all the installation components, jeopardizing their proper functionality. Additionally, this phenomenon is also associated with high order voltage and current harmonics, which adversely spread out into the entire network. This paper predetermines the ferroresonance solution of single-phase toroidal transformers with rated power up to 10 kVA. The study is conducted by solving the nonlinear differential equations system that model the transient process. Thus, the voltage and current waveforms are predicated and critically analyzed. Supplementary, some mitigation solutions to these phenomenon undesirable consequences are suggested.

articleTitle: Comparison between conventional wind measurement systems and SODAR systems for remote sensing including examination of real wind data
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In order to design a profitable wind farm, the local wind conditions are measured to perform a detailed wind site assessment. The choice of appropriate measurement equipment and its correct installation are crucial. Measuring equipment must perform as precisely as possible to ensure the quality of data essential for producing accurate wind site assessments. In this paper a comparison is performed between wind data measurements of SODAR system and meteorological mast at different height levels and using different SODAR settings.

articleTitle: Electrical loads and profiles of public buildings
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The electrical loads characteristics and work regime define the type of the load curves (profiles) for the various economic subjects, the electrical power's effective usage and the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC). With the technological development and its accessibility, the equipment in manufacturing plants and public buildings is replaced. This requires periodic researches of the electrical loads. This report refers to the classification of the basic electrical loads' types in the public buildings in relation with their purpose, the electromagnetic disturbance upon the electrical power quality (EMC) and the power factor. Apart from this, the load curves (profiles) of specific public buildings have been reviewed and analyzed. Their indicators (characteristics) have been defined, various problems have been commented and decision-making methods have been proposed. The results from this research can be used both for electrical power supply design of similar objects and for exploitation from engineers and power managers.

articleTitle: Forecasting software for hourly transmission losses
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The Bulgarian electricity market rules require from the transmission system operator, to procure electricity for covering transmission grid losses on hourly base before day-ahead gate closure. In this paper is presented a software solution for day-ahead forecasting of hourly transmission losses that is based on statistical approach of the impacting factors correlations and uses as inputs numerical weather predictions.

articleTitle: Some aspects of using real and virtual experiment in teaching electrical engineering
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The combination of a real experiment with a virtual one in the electrical engineering education increases the students' interest for the subject and makes the material easier to comprehend. In the following paper, there are examples about demonstrating such complementation and about checking and visualisation an analysis of simple electrical circuits.

Author Keywords: problems in the electrical engineering education

articleTitle: Analysis of permanent magnet synchronous machines used for hybrid vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents various simulation analyses of permanent magnet synchronous machines used for hybrid vehicles. Two machines of different rated power are analyzed by the software programs FEMM and Ansys Maxwell 2015. Based on the analyses, the following quantities and characteristics of the synchronous machines are determined: flux linkages, harmonic content of the electromotive force curve, electromagnetic torque and losses in various parts of the machines. 3D electromagnetic and thermal numerical models of the analyzed machines are also developed.

articleTitle: Analysis of errors in distribution networks power losses calculations with relation to the time discretization intervals
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper examines the errors occurring in power loss evaluation for electrical distribution networks as a result of the different (increased) duration of the time discretization intervals used for the step approximation of the load profiles of the supplied consumers. The relation between these errors and the magnitude of the index called “form factor” is also a subject of interest. Using the estimations of errors in function of the single time interval duration for each particular value of the form factor, and calculating the real magnitude of the form factor for the respective network, one could decide about the proper discretization interval for particular cases of networks supplying various types of consumers. The developed methodology could be further used in more comprehensive studies for definite clarification of the considered relations.

articleTitle: Studying the magnetic field of three-phase induction device with split-phase
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Induction heating and melting is a thermal method of metal treatment widely used in practice. The advantages of this method are high speed of heating, great efficiency factor, small losses, possibility for local heating and others. The main problem of the three-phase induction devices with a radial position of the inductors is the presence of a rotating magnetic field. The present paper presents a study of the electromagnetic field in the specific design of a three-phase induction device, where one phase is made of two identical coils located one opposite the other (split phase).

Author Keywords: electromagnetic induction and three-phase induction device

articleTitle: Influence of the tower construction of electrical power line 110 kV over the risk of electrical field exposure
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents investigation about the influence of the construction of the used in electrical power line 110 kV towers over the risk assessment from electrical field exposure. A calculation approach is used for determination of the electric field intensity under overhead power lines without a lightning protection wire. The authors have developed a computer program based on the mirror images approach. The program calculates the intensity E of the electric field at a point on an arbitrary height from the ground, transversely from the center of the tower of the transmission line 110 kV, the current flowing through a person I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub>, located in the area of the point and the power absorbed by the body P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub>.

articleTitle: Design of digital PI regulators from experimental frequency response of electrohydraulic steering system
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Paper presents the tuning of two digital PI regulators for electrohydraulic steering system designed for low velocity mobile machines. Regulators are based on experimentally measured frequency response of a steering system. This response is approximated with two rational transfer functions. They are basis for design of corresponding digital PI regulators with iterative optimization procedure in MATLAB / Simulink. Regulator parameters are programmed into a microcontroller for mobile applications and their performances are compared through natural experiment on the steering electrohydraulic drive system with digital control.

articleTitle: The short circuit currents calculations model for integral forecasting of the switching facilities residual life
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The electric power systems are among the most complex engineering systems. The present systems are characterized by the high rate of different physical processes reaction, the complexity of the electrical energy storage on an industrial scale and the necessity of the automatic equipment application for the system management.

articleTitle: Influence of the pole shapes on the force characteristics of a DC solenoid actuator
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the results from a numerical study of the force characteristics of a DC solenoid actuator with three different shapes of the poles: a truncated cone, a cylindrical stepped shape and a flat shape. 3D computer models have been synthesized for the purpose in the software product ANSYS Maxwell, with the help of which the force characteristics at different supply voltages have been obtained. Comparison has been made with experimental data.

articleTitle: Filtration of deteriorated signals used in the control systems by orthogonal wavelets
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The possibilities of orthogonal wavelet functions for filtration of noisy signals used in the control systems are discussed in the present paper. Signals with high level noise/signal ratio are filtered. Different families of wavelet functions are used. The effectiveness of filtration by orthogonal and compactly supported wavelets is evaluated. The results are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: The cross-border trade impact on the transmission losses
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Due to the current path of least resistance, the loop flows are natural phenomena in interconnected power systems. In addition, the cross-border trade causes transits trough the hosted power systems from the sink to the source. As result, due to transits, transmission losses are increased in hosted power systems. This paper detects the main statistical correlation between the cross-border trade and the transmission losses, in order to improve the Bulgarian transmission system operator forecast for procurement of electricity to cover the losses and to minimize imbalances.

articleTitle: Effects of cogging torque reduction techniques applied to surface mounted PMSMs with distributed windings
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper investigates what effects different cogging torque reduction techniques, have on the cogging torque waveforms and air-gap flux density of surface mounted PMSMs with distributed windings and large number of slots per pole. Methods such as magnet step skew, stator teeth dummy slots and magnet pole shaping are the main scope of the paper, as they do not result in unwanted rotor unbalances. The effects of different number of magnet pole segments and different skew angles on the cogging torque waveforms are also depicted. Two dimensional Finite element analysis (FEA) is performed in order to obtain the cogging torque peak-to-peak variations and air-gap flux density distribution.

articleTitle: Application of recursive methods for parameter estimation in adaptive pole placement control of DC motor
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The adaptive control covers a set of methods that provide a systematic approach for automatic control in real-time. Recursive methods for parameter estimation have to meet the requirements for identification algorithms in real time. This is determined from the fact that the adjustment of the model after the submission of new data from monitoring, and the development of new control action should be made in a single cycle of discretization. In this paper is proposed an application of recursive methods for parameter estimation in adaptive pole placement control of DC motor.

articleTitle: Investigation of the dielectric permittivity of anodic aluminum oxide substrates for multi-chip modules
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present article describes the investigations, performed in order to determine some dielectric characteristics of anodic aluminum oxide (AAO), obtained by electrochemical anodization process. The AAO layer is grown directly on aluminum substrates, considered as suitable carriers for multi-chip modules (MCM). Test samples for measurements of the dielectric permittivity and loss tangent were elaborated by anodization in 5% oxalic acid electrolyte. The chosen measurement technique is based on the ring resonator method. The values, obtained for the S21 parameter of a two-port ring resonator, were used to determine the permittivity of the board substrate.

articleTitle: Investigation of the exploitation modes of a special type magnetic separator
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present work is dedicated to the study of a separator with permanent magnets designed for processing of non-fat sunflower meal before it enters a ball mill.

articleTitle: Concept for development of 2D virtual reality laboratory in electrical circuits: Basic equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the present the feasibility of a concept for development of a virtual reality laboratory in electrical circuits is verified. The concept aims to create an engine, which would allow to implement custom virtual equipment, whose behavior and GUI is loaded from a database and implemented dynamically. The implementation is based on variables, which are manipulated and visualized by the different equipment components - switches, buttons, potentiometers and indicators. The obtained results, show that the suggested approach is feasible and the basic laboratory equipment and its behavior, can be implemented successfully.

articleTitle: Development of a novel Coaxial Magnetic Gear
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Magnetic Gears (MGs) offer many advantages compared to mechanical gears such as reduced maintenance, high reliability and inherent over load protection. Among various MGs, a Surface Permanent Magnet (SPM) type Coaxial Magnetic Gear (CMG), which may be accepted to be a classical CMG, is may be preferable owing to its high torque transmission capability. The main drawback of this CMG is that the gear ratio as well as efficiency is highly affected by the speed increase due to severe Eddy current losses in permanent magnets. Having permanent magnets on the outer side of the rotor is another drawback of the classical CMG since these magnets are experience sever centrifugal forces as the speed increases and thus the MG may encounter serious damages. In order to overcome the mentioned drawbacks of classical CMGs, this paper introduces a new type CMG whose inner part contains interior permanent magnets (IPMs) rather than SPMs. A finite element based tool has been used to design the proposed magnetic gear and its performance has been investigated and compared with those of conventional CMG for various speed conditions. According to the analysis results, decrease in gear ratio with respect to the speed is significantly suppressed and thus efficiency is improved. Additionally, proposed CMG provides less amount of torque ripples.

articleTitle: Effect of static or dynamic eccentricities on the unbalanced magnetic pull in Doubly-Fed Induction Machines
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A small eccentricity in a Doubly-Fed Induction Machine can have a huge impact and results in a big Unbalanced Magnetic Pull. This paper presents an analytical method that has been developed to compute the UMP due to a static or a dynamic eccentricity. This method considers saturation in the electrical steel and the damping effect of the circulating currents flowing in the parallel paths of the stator. It has been developed under no load conditions. The last part of this paper will be a comparison between the results obtained analytically and the ones obtained by finite-element computations.

articleTitle: Combined mobile robots motion control using information as voice and gesture commands from audio and thermal visual sensors
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Motion is one of the main functions of the mobile robots [1]. The problem to achieve the precise control of the mobile robot motion doesn't have a unique solution. This is because there are varieties of situations of mobile robot motion: from motion with full human guidance to mobile robot motion self-control usually tracking some object or human.

articleTitle: Features in the selection and operation of AC motors for electric propulsion system in ship
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The aim of this paper was to evaluate the features in the selection and operation of AC Motors for electric propulsion system for ships. Presented are recommendations concerning the design of these machines due to the specific field of application. Operation of engines is associated with the use of modern converters and are shown the directions of their development.

articleTitle: Overview of heat transfer aspects for inductors and transformers for power electronics
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents an overview of heat transfer specifics of magnetic components for power electronics. The loss dissipation in power electronics is mainly based on convection and radiation heat transfer, thus improved models for estimating these mechanisms are presented and compared. The focus is on improved models of convection heat transfer utilizing derived values of the exponents of component height and precise view on the corresponding surface calculations and length of the air path in the equation for h<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>. Further, an accurate presentation of corresponding surfaces for convection and radiation heat transfer ate discussed and heat transfer model to define the hot spot temperature. Useful examples of the presented improvements are calculated for common sizes of EE type ferrite cores in power electronics, thus demonstrating the accurate heat transfer data for these magnetic components.

Author Keywords: convection heat transfer for magnetic components
heat dissipartin capability of magnetic components

articleTitle: IP-based smart sensors for energy metering and efficient HVAC infrastructure in buildings
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Today, HVAC systems are responsible for 15 to 60% of the total energy consumption of a building, depending on its intended use. Effective and efficient utilization of energy and the reduction of energy losses are of particular importance in this regard. In recent years, studies examining the HVAC system parameters for reducing energy consumption have revealed the need for higher performance regarding the temperature, capacity and control strategies in the resulting systems. In this study, a system was developed with IP-based smart sensors for improving the energy efficiency of the HVAC systems used in a building by determining the characteristics of the building and measuring its thermal losses. With this system, the detection of heat loss besides that of user-induced faults, as well as the reduction of these losses can be achieved. It is to this aim that the designed IP electronic system provides for access to offices via the Internet, while output data are provided through the features operating to reduce energy loss.

articleTitle: Influence of the excitation regime of turbo-generators on the own needs supply stable operation
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: An investigation on the reasons for failure of the own needs supply in one of the blocks of a big electrical power plant in Bulgaria has been presented. The investigation presented is based on a computer model, which adequacy is experimentally verified. The computational investigations with the model show that the reliability of the own needs supply depends on the excitation regime of the generators.

articleTitle: Harmonic impact testing on synchronous generator protection
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In order to have proper operation of the “relay” protection devices, their behavior shall be studied and tested for different possible operational conditions. The harmonic spectrum in the supervised circuits may affect the protection functions. Harmonics can be generated in the primary circuits by faults, non-linear loads, converters, etc. Harmonics can also be induced in the secondary circuits by electromagnetic interference paths, but this problem shall be eliminated with proper design of secondary protection and control circuits [10, 11]. The paper presents approached used to test percentage differential protection function in case of different harmonic content. Longitudinal differential protection function (ANSI 87) was subject of tests. Generator protection device was selected and the function was tested for different application cases. All experiments were conducted in the “Relay protection” laboratory of the Technical University-Sofia.

articleTitle: Torque ripple suppression in surface mounted PMSMs with distributed windings
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper examines the torque ripple variation of surface mounted PMSMs with distributed windings and large number of slots per pole. The effect of established cogging torque reduction methods such as magnet step skewing, stator dummy slots and magnet pole shaping on the torque ripple variations and magnetic flux production is investigated, as these methods address the same factors that influence torque ripple. Finite element analysis is performed in order to obtain the torque ripple and air-gap flux density waveforms. The effect of each applied method on the machines torque production and peak-to-peak variations are also presented. Magnet pole skewing method appears to be most effective when taking into consideration both torque ripple suppression and torque production.

articleTitle: Modeling of the behavior of high pressure discharge lamps in circuits with ballast
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the present paper the values of the active resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub> and the inductance L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub> of the electromagnetic ballast are determined analytically and by simulations with program OrCAD Capture. The characteristics U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> = U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> (t) of the studying discharge lamps in considered electrical circuit are measured experimentidly and then data are approximated and put in the OrCAD Capture models. The optimal results for R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub> and I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> guarantee the RMS value of the current I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> passed through each of the considered lamps. Different types of fluorescent and high pressure sodium lamps with nonlinear volt-amper characteristics are analyzed. The simulations' results are compared with the analytical ones, calculated by the measured data for U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> = U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> (t). Essentially they are closely to the actual ones, because the approximation of the characteristic U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> = U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> (t) for each studying lamp is more accurate because of the fact that it uses bigger number of basic points than the existing approximation.

Author Keywords: active resistance and inductance of the ballast

articleTitle: Magnetoelectric position sensors for automotive application
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper it is proposed to use magnetoelectric material as the sensing element of position sensors for car. Proposed ME position sensor has several advantages against the traditional one such as smaller size and weight. Magnetostrictive-piezoelectric layered structure based on PZT and Metglas was used as sensor. The designed sensor showed the peak voltage pulse of about 150 mV. Sensors were tested on a real internal combustion engine of a car.

articleTitle: Coupled electric — Thermal model for SR-drives
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In automotive applications detailed multi-domain modeling and testing at component and sub-component level is necessary to improve the understanding and design capabilities for higher performances and lower costs. New and faster tools are required to reduce the development and testing time and effort for electrical actuated automotive sub-systems. The paper presents a thermal model to simulate and evaluate the behavior of a Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) at sub-system level under specific automotive testing scenarios. The model is created in a multi-domain simulation environment (AMESim©) that can be coupled to other commercially or open source available physics-based tools, for a more accurate evaluation.

articleTitle: Investigation of the capacitive interference of overhead multi-line power system
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The electromagnetic interference generated by multi-line power system for high voltage is considered. Capacitive penetration of electromagnetic disturbance in neighbouring electrical facilities, pipe system and vehicle located near overhead high-voltage lines are analyzed. A method for evaluation of the capacitive interference is proposed. The mutual capacitances and the interference voltage of low voltage line, arising from the disturbance by capacitive coupling are determined. The distribution of this voltage in the vicinity of high-voltage multi-conductor lines is obtained. The results, presented in this paper, illustrate the mechanism of capacitive interface between overhead multi-line power system and neighbouring electrical facilities.

articleTitle: Decision making in transformer manufacturing companies with help of ERP business software
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper describes the idea of using ERP business software in transformer manufacturing companies for decision making improvement process. A new model combines technical calculations (basic dimensions and elements of vector diagram) with business analysis (MRP, CRP, Cost estimate) in one system, SAP ERP.

articleTitle: Optimization of medium voltage backup power supply strategies for high power pump aggregates
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: There are industrial parties where huge quantities of water are used for cooling. The need of cooling at the same time is important part of the technology process and is essential for reliability and proper operation of the plant. A very high requirement towards uninterruptedness of water flow exists in that case so the same is applied to the electrical power supply of the pump aggregates. Pump aggregates are usually fed through a backup power supply system that comprises of complex electrical topology with switchover capability. A pump station of a big power plant is considered here. The station consists of 20 pumps driven by high power induction motors operating on a medium voltage (6.3 kV). The power supply schematics of the pump station is shown on Figure 1. The pump station is connected to the electrical power system by two feeders at 220 kV level. The four bus ducts (denoted on Figure 1 from S-I to S-IV) are fed by two identical three winding transformers. Five pump aggregates are connected to each bus section. As it is seen by the Fig. 1 the power supply conception supposes implementation of power supply switchover therefore bus ducts are connected to automatic transfer switches (ATS). The power supply changeover increases the reliability of the entire pump station operation which is the main concern in that type of power plants. The paper studies the transients in eventual change of supply direction and their influence on electrical supply parameters.

articleTitle: Modelling of magnetic concentrators in induction heating systems
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The efficiency of the induction heating systems is essential in the modern productions. In the present paper, through FEM modelling, the influence of magnetic concentrators on the efficiency of such system is studied.

articleTitle: Power control of PMSG for wind turbine using maximum torque per ampere strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper deals with implementation of maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) control strategy for a permanent magnet synchronous generator as a part of a wind energy conversion system (WESC). The variable speed wind turbines require appropriate control of the generator power, toque and speed in order to maximize the energy production under varying wind speed using appropriate MPPT algorithms. The power electronic converter is used to control the generator current and consequently - its torque and speed. Thus, allowing to adjust the operating point of the turbine in the maximum of the power curve for the current speed of the wind. The work focuses on the combination of the MPPT algorithm and MTPA strategy for control of a PMSG in a wind turbine. Appropriate mathematical and computer models are presented. The simulations are done under Matlab/Simulink environment. The results show the possibility to combine both algorithms to achieve tight maximum power tracking with the wind turbine and the generator.

articleTitle: GPSS language as tool for reliability simulations
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article, the use of the universal environment GPSS is suggested, which is intended to perform discrete reliability simulations on systems for mass service. This is achieved by using various distributions included into the program pack, which practically cover all items in the reliability analysis. Simulation can be performed on Markov and semi-Markov processes and the connected with them Poisson flows, and the reliability interpretations, which are based on a system of differential equations of Kolmogorov, to be illustrated in a very clear way. According to the authors' studies, the simulation environment GPSS is competitive to the existing reliability programs, i.e. it ofïers better flexibility when certifying the workload (analogous to the intensity of failures) and parameters of service (respectively intensity of recovery). In the environment, independent failures and general failures could be easily modeled. In the example a homologous TMR system is observed.

articleTitle: A Monte Carlo algorithm for determining the point of collapse of power flow equations
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Major drawback of existing algorithms for voltage stability calculations is that they rely on predetermined loading conditions of the network to estimate the distance to system's collapse. i.e. algorithms such as the continuation power flow and others based on optimization routines only consider single possible path to the instability. This paper presents an algorithm for voltage stability boundary assessment based on Monte Carlo method. It is capable to generate many random paths/directions, which are used to load the network until a bifurcation point is reached. This algorithm could be useful as a reference for other algorithms to compare results in terms of minimal distance to collapse. Two test cases are included in the paper to demonstrate and prove the properties and capabilities of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The study of bulk loading in high-temperature resistance furnaces
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: To simulate the thermal processes in electric furnaces it is quite convenient to use the finite element method in a two- and three-dimensional setting. The thermal conductivity is a property of the continuum and in the simulation of non-continuous environs it is necessary when using the finite element method to resort to a significant complication of the model, which significantly increases the time of the calculations especially in three-dimensional statement. In the design of the furnace structure it was necessary to achieve the required uniformity of the distribution of temperature inside the load, given the nature of heat exchange processes taking place in it, and taking into account the mutual arrangement of the heater and the platten with the load. The load by virtue of its characteristics in the beginning behaves like a thermo technical massive body, but with the increase of the temperature grows the role of radiant heat exchange within layers of the load to such an extent that the temperature gradient along the radius becomes insignificant. The results of the research showed an opportunity of significant simplification of the model of bulk load during thermal calculations in high temperature furnaces with a predominance of radiation heat transfer between the individual pieces of the batch.

articleTitle: Recognition of heat-conductive filling agents of a thermoelectric refrigeration system with Focused Time — Delay Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Neural Networks are an information processing paradigm that is inspired from the biological nervous systems, such as the human brain, which process information. In the system we use Focused Time-Delay Neural Network for recognizing heat-conductive filling agents It is composed of a large number of highly interconnected processing elements (neurons) working in symbiosis to solve many kinds of problems. In this paper a system for recognition of heat-conductive filling agents of a thermoelectric refrigeration system with Focused Time-Delay Neural Network is suggested.

articleTitle: Method of design public key infrastructure for secure audio information transmission in multimedia systems
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The importance to protect from non-authorized access of audio information transmission in multimedia systems is very high. [1] There are a lot of methods and algorithms suitable for the general case to secure transmission of all kind of data, including video and audio as a part of the multimedia information [2] In this article is proposed a special methodological approach to design and implementation of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) in order to secure the transmission of audio information and protect it from unauthorized access through encryption keeping its confidentiality and integrity.

articleTitle: Power and energy parameters of the inductor with an electromagnetic shield
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the practice of engineering calculations the method of determining the power inductor and power settings using the equivalent circuit is commonly used. In numerous sources the method of calculation of inductors with a ferromagnetic screen, as well as inductors of increased or high frequency unshielded designs is given. An inductor with a loading in such a furnace is placed inside a non-magnetic conductive body - screen made of, for example, a copper alloy. When calculating the inductor with an electromagnetic conductive shield, the use of self-induction coefficients listed in the sources is not entirely correct. The coefficient of self-induction shows the ratio of inductance of the opening of an empty inductor and of inductance of an empty inductor with consideration of the return flow circuit. For the calculation of the self-inductance coefficient of a shielded inductor in a special software package. To determine the estimated value of the coefficient of self-induction a comparison of the results of the calculation using the method of equivalent circuits with the corresponding results of simulation in a special software package with the use of the method of final elements was made.

articleTitle: Physical model of an electric vehicle for research of dynamic operating modes
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents mathematical and physical model of permanent magnet synchronous machine which enable simulation and experimental studies of various dynamic modes of operation of electric vehicle in laboratory environment. The mathematical model is realized in Matlab programming language. It provides useful information for investigation of the dynamic modes including control strategies related to recuperation modes. Several operation modes are experimentally studied and analyzed using the physical model.

articleTitle: Induction crucible furnace with dual frequency power supply
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article deals with the design and power scheme of an induction crucible furnace with a capacity of 10 tons for steel from a dual frequency converter. A comparison of the dynamics of the melt homogenization process in the furnace of the proposed design with a similar process in a conventional furnace is compared. Calculations showed that at the same power, the speed of metal movement in the bath increased more than 6 times, and the rate of temperature equalization increased more than 10-fold due to the change in the metal flow trajectory in the bath.

articleTitle: Influence of cold air plasma treatment on thermobonded PET nonwoven textile
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Plasma surface treatments show distinct advantages, because they are able to modify the surface properties of inert materials, sometimes with environment friendly devices. On textile surfaces, three main effects can be obtained depending on the treatment conditions: the cleaning effect, the increase of microroughness and the production of radicals to obtain hydrophilic surfaces. The advantage of such plasma treatments is that the modification turns out to be restricted in the uppermost layers of the substrate, thus not affecting the overall desirable bulk properties. The aim of this paper is to change surface properties of the light nonwoven materials from polyethyleneterephthalate (PET) fibers, by treatment in cold atmospheric technological plasma at industrial frequency. A diode parallel-plate type electrode system, consisting in a high voltage plate electrode and grounded plate electrode, is employed. The surface of nonwoven PET material were modified and cleaned by a combined plasma-chemical process. Mass change and air permeability measurements are carried out to study the evolution of hydrophobic change at different working plasma treatment regimes. The main results show a good correlation between the cold plasma treatment and volume mechanical properties.

articleTitle: Solar potential for building integrated solar collectors: Application in Bulgaria, Romania & France
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the first results obtained in the frame of an international project of collaboration between Romania, Bulgaria and France concerning the integration of renewable energy systems into building and urban area. A solar radiation model, previously validated, is used to calculate the available solar energy in various planes (with various inclination and azimuth) for a photovoltaic or thermal conversion. The influence of the inclination of the solar irradiance via the season, monthly and annual solar energy for French, Romanian and Bulgarian sites. Using a Building Integrated Solar System (BISS) can have positive or negative impacts on the availability of the solar energy. A good compromise must be found between an aesthetic integration and an optimal inclination and orientation. Architect and building designers must take into account the utilization of the heat and the daily profile of utilization which can justify a special orientation.

articleTitle: Real-time model of switched reluctance drive based on a LUT magnetization curve for educational purposes
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper discusses the implementation of a real-time model of a switched reluctance motor drive for which the parameters of its magnetisation curve are represented by the data in a look-up table. A method of cubic interpolation has been applied for the look-up table approximation in order to provide a high accuracy and realistic performance of the modelled motor drive. The model structure has been optimised for real-time execution in a motion control microcontroller operating under PWM frequency up to 40 kHz. The model is designed to be used in the students' coursework on the specialist subject of electric drive control.

articleTitle: Development of model for automatic tutor in e-learning environment based on student reactions extraction using facial recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In e-learning environment, the main function of the tutor is to provide assistance to one or a group of learners. We distinguish between two types of tutors: The reactive tutor who responds simply to the explicit requests of the learner and the proactive tutor who takes the initiative to provide support to the learner and offer him advice at the appropriate time. Our goal is to create an environment where the proactive role of tutor is to assist and monitor a single learner during the learning process. In our case tutor should have his own problem-solving analysis, his own ability to model the learner and his own expertise in generating explanations. In this paper, an automatic tutor based on face recognition and emotion recognition system is proposed for a distant learning platform, the first step for face recognition system is face detection for this we are using the viola jones object detect algorithm that can provide the detection in real time. Features extraction and tracking is the base of emotion detection for that the KLT algorithm will be applied after face detection. These algorithms will be performed in Matlab as programming tool focused in image processing and facial recognition. This proposed method is used to create an automatic tutor that helps assisting the learner during an educational process in e-learning. The name of this Facial and Audio Recognition Automatic Tutoring Model is FARAT.

articleTitle: An algorithm for fast determining the point of collapse of power flow equations based on singular value decomposition
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: It is of practical and research interest to identify when the power flow equations collapse, i.e. to find the maximum loading point of the power system and its distance from the current operating point. An important information for system operators is the security margin between the operating point and maximum loading one. The existing algorithms use the present load distribution among nodes and multiply it by a loading factor until the saddle node bifurcation is approached. This means that a predetermined direction in the multi-dimensional space of nodal power injections is selected. However, this direction may not necessarily lead to the nearest or most probable bifurcation point. This paper proposes an algorithm based on singular value decomposition (SVD) to identify the shortest path to approach the instability boundary.

articleTitle: Piezoelectric energy harvesting device with nanobranched ZnO on Polymer/Metal/Polymer coated flexible substrate
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This work reports about the fabrication of piezoelectric energy harvesting with ZnO nanostructure grown on polymeric based electrode. The piezoelectric film exhibits nanobranched morphology, which provide favorable conditions for dipoles orientation and thus the device is characterized with relatively low dielectric losses in the range of 0.4–3.9×10−2 and piezoelectric voltage of 3.8V at 4.8 kg mechanical loading. The minimum weight at which piezoelectric reaction arises is 3 gr, corresponding to generated piezoelectric voltage of 200mV.

articleTitle: Electroenergetical training laboratory with remote acess to stands
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Some issues of special disciplines require closer attention than now, which explains the need for the development of specialized laboratory stands for these disciplines. The Intellectual Laboratory is implemented in the form of an electronic course, which contains the necessary theoretical material, and is also equipped with an automated system for monitoring the performance of laboratory work. Conducting laboratory workshops is an essential stage in the training of specialists of any profile. At present, many manufacturers offer laboratory stands meeting a wide range of studied disciplines, both general and specialized, but it is quite difficult to cover the broad subject matter of the topics discussed in the disciplines of the electric power profile.

articleTitle: Energy — Efficient control of double inverter-fed induction motor
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The influence of the rotor currents frequency and the magnetization curve approximation strategy on the electrical machine losses at the minimum total losses at low loads control algorithm implementation for double-fed induction motor is presented.

articleTitle: The evolutionary optimization approach for voltage profile estimation in a radial distribution network with a decreased number of measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The procedure for estimation of voltage profile in a radial distribution network considering decreased number of measurements is presented in the text. The proposed procedure is based on hypothesis that feeder voltage profile in case of the limited number of feeder measurements can be successfully estimated using evolutionary optimization approach. The procedure consists of two main steps. In the first step, the location of the voltage measurements are determined with aim to have as small as possible the number of the locations. This is done by applying the analytical mathematical procedure. After the measurement locations are defined, in the second procedure step the optimization aims to estimate whole voltage profile is performed employing the evolutionary algorithm. The proposed procedure is tested on two test radial distribution feeders to verify the proposed procedure.

articleTitle: Investigation of a new technology of controlling electrical apparatus via a smart phone
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper discusses the present possibilities for controlling electrical apparatus via smart phone and implementing newer technologies in this process.

articleTitle: Two-stage low-frequency square-wave electronic ballast with analog and digital control
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper investigates a two-stage low-frequency square-wave (LFSW) electronic ballast with a combined analogue and digital control. The first stage of the ballast is a power factor correction (PFC) converter and the second is a half-bridge (HB) converter with an igniter. The advantage of the proposed scheme compared to conventional LFSW ballasts, is including an improved modified HB circuit. This approach contributes to two benefits regarding the body-diode ruggedness and its reverse recovery charge process. The combined analogue and digital control additionally provides a high operating frequency range. Further, an improved methodology is proposed for the design of the inductors, including eddy current loss estimation and core type selection. Finally, design application considerations are derived concerning the proposed electronic ballast.

articleTitle: Research on the temperature field of a combined device for cooking ZANUSSI
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Studying the thermal field of household appliances for food preparation is an important element of their design. Determining heat losses is directly related to the assessment of their effectiveness. For this purpose, mathematical models were developed based on the finite element method. Their adequacy was assessed by experimental studies. The data obtained enable the simulation of different operational modes and the further research in the field of their effective management.

articleTitle: Bounded global irradiation prediction based on multilayer perceptron and time series formalism
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: As global solar radiation forecasting is a very important challenge, several methods are devoted to this goal with different levels of accuracy and confidence. In this study we propose to better understand how the uncertainty is propagated in the context of global radiation time series forecasting using machine learning. Indeed we propose to decompose the error considering four kinds of uncertainties: the error due to the measurement, the variability of time series, the machine learning uncertainty and the error related to the horizon. All these components of the error allow to determinate a global uncertainty generating a prediction bands related to the prediction efficiency. We also have defined a reliability index which could be very interesting for the grid manager in order to estimate the validity of predictions. We have experimented this method on a multilayer perceptron which is a popular machine learning technique. We have shown that the global error and its components are essentials to quantify in order to estimate the reliability of the model outputs. The described method has been successfully applied to four meteorological stations in Mediterranean area.

articleTitle: Design of a low permanent magnet mass hybrid excited flux switching machine for a PHEV application
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents an optimized design of a Hybrid-Excited Flux-Switching machine (HEFSM) with a very low quantity of permanent magnet (PM) for a Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) traction application. The design examined is the result of an evolutionary optimization algorithm. The adopted solution needs only 650g of PMs to reach a maximum power of 80kW over a wide speed range (2,600 to 12,000rpm) and a peak torque of 233Nm at 2,605rpm. The contribution of the field excitation coils is appraised, particularly on the back-emf, the mean torque and the core loss levels. The global performances of the machine are presented through efficiency and losses maps and the contribution of the PMs is also discussed.

articleTitle: Indoor propagation of signals between wireless sensor nodes
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: “Log-normal shadowing model” is used here for predicting large-scale coverage for wireless sensor networks. Applying this model helps one to estimate the energy capacity of WSN (wireless sensor network), before such systems to be deployed.

articleTitle: Critical Meteorological Conditions and the Electrical Power Balance in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In accordance with European directives, the liberalization of Bulgarian electricity market began in 2004. Since July 1st 2007 the electricity market was partially liberalized. The open market implies producers, consumers and electricity traders entering into transactions at freely negotiated prices. Currently in Bulgaria there are two segments of the electricity market operating in parallel - a regulated and a liberalized one. The balance of the power generation in the Electrical Power System (EPS) is affected by the respective power generation technologies vulnerable to the meteorological conditions [1, 2, 3, 4]. The underestimation of the critical meteorological conditions can impose problems in the power balance with all resulting technical and financial effects [11]. Studies have been made to take into account the different aspects of power generation technology and data analysis [5, 6, 7]. A generalized approach can help to combine the different sources of information and indices to form prognosis of the power balance in the EPS [8, 9, 10].

articleTitle: The methodology of risk evaluation for power equipment technical state assessment
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper provides the methodology of power network equipment technical state assessment risk evaluation to ensure effective power network operation and optimization of maintenance and repair schedules. The analysis of existing approaches for risk assessment is carried out from the point of mathematical formulation and existing application practice. The case study illustrates the calculation of technical state assessment risks for 110 kV oil-filled power transformer, based on neuro-fuzzy inference approach.

articleTitle: Processing efficiency of plasma-aided porous media finishing
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The efficiency of a plasma-aided finishing process e.g., surface impregnation can be predicted only by setting two basic parameters of the real wood porous surface and the actual impregnating solution — surface free energy and surface tension. Successful finishing can be expected if the process efficiency parameter take a positive value after a specified aging time of the plasma-chemical surface activation −2 or 24 hours.

articleTitle: Monitoring system for senseless energy characteristics identification of inverter-fed single-phase collector motor drive
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Adaptive magnetizing current observer of single-phase collector motor has been proposed in the paper. The electro-mechanical energy conversion in a single-phase collector motor is being represented trough a system of non-linear differential equations that includes the resistances and dynamic inductivities of the armature and field winding, spinning E.M.F. The observer gain matrix is designed to achieve quickly and accurately performance by the definition of a non-linear reference model. The experimental results show the improvements with regard to the robustness of parameter uncertainties and load disturbances in the proposed scheme. The observer performance has been very good even though the load torque is varying.

articleTitle: Simulation of air transformers with different sizes and geometry
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper, FEA simulation will be done for several coils with different sizes and geometry. The environment, which will be used for the simulations, is "ANSYS® - Electronics desktop". The package for direct current and low frequency electromagnetic simulations is called "Maxwell®". In the second chapter, the simulation design is described, and all the parameters are set. In the third and fourth chapter, the results of the simulation are presented, and its comparison to a real system is discussed.
