articleTitle: Application of automated photovoltaic and lighting infrastructural system APhoLIS-energy points
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The report presents the project for building of novel technical solution for use of photovoltaic systems integrated in street lighting with grid-on connection and storage functions with accumulators. The technical solution is based on the implementation of local energy centers - energy points, representing photovoltaic systems of class solar tracker, inverter stations, storage elements (batteries), controllers for system configuration and own-developed software platform.

articleTitle: Simulation of the shading in photovoltaic systems
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a model of photovoltaic system in the Matlab/Simulink environment for simulation of different shadings and diode protection for educational purposes. The aim is to illustrate the influence of the shading on the performances of the photovoltaic modules and to estimate the effect of different types of diode protections. Thus the students' education is improved and their capacity - increased.

articleTitle: Optimization of the solar thermal collectors integration in buildings for DHW production
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the first results obtained in the frame of an international project of collaboration between Romania, Bulgaria and France concerning the integration of renewable energy systems into buildings and urban areas. The study is focused on the dynamic simulations of the energy performance resulting from the use of a solar thermal system designed for the DHW production, in the case of an existing building. Three influence factors have been analyzed during this multi-parametric study: the collectors cardinal orientation, the local climate and the DHW consumption profiles, retaining two daily and annual DHW profiles: office and residential, for the same daily hot water consumptions. The results show strong dependencies of the solar system energy performance with these factors.

articleTitle: Method for estimation the threshold frequencies of the electrical machines
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper deals with the vibrations which affect the electrical machines. Due to the widespread use of such machines in the industry, it is of great importance to study and determine their vibrations and threshold frequencies. There are methods by which the the threshold frequencies can be calculated, but they involve heavy computations. A method is proposed and an algorithm with a computer program making it possible to easily determine the threshold frequencies through the geometric parameters of the machine and to predict the operation resource of the electromechanical objects.

articleTitle: Model-based virtual product development and data control with PLM
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The growing complexity of products and processes in industrial production require new methods of processing technical information and searching for new IT solutions. Fast and adequate solutions can be made on the basis of extensive information and long-term experience. This is possible when the implementation of automated systems is seen as a general-functional process in which the emphasis is placed on the rational use of the collected information. Products such as PLM have the task of managing a variety of technical information and work effectively to optimize the collection, storage and use of this information. The PLM systems are basic in the virtual development of products. Their successful installation and operation require special care and qualified engineers.

articleTitle: Determination of control sensor position in a clapper type electromagnet using FEM
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: 3D model of a clapper type electromagnet is built and its magnetic field is analyzed using the finite element method and MAGNET software. Distribution of the magnetic flux density is obtained and on its basis the position of two-axis magnetic field sensor for electromagnet control is proposed.

articleTitle: Loading curve optimization for electric networks efficiency improvement
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper provides a methodology for substation loading curve optimization for power losses reduction and power network development deferral. The objective function of the problem provides costs minimization, however the optimization process is based on technical criteria, taking into account power system operation modes, electric energy consumers behavior and power equipment loading capacity. The mathematical calculations are carried out using genetic algorithms, because they prove to be effective for finite-solution optimization tasks. Proposed methodology was verified using real practical problem formulation.

articleTitle: Automated photovoltaic and lighting infrastructural system — APhoLIS
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a new concept, technical solution and components of technical system for highly efficient photovoltaic installations integrated into street and area lighting with two-way power transmission without use of local electric accumulators. The main objective of the study is development of photovoltaic installations using built or new infrastructure for street, park or area lighting, and this type of installations will exceed the efficiency of the existing lighting systems with solar modules and accumulators.

articleTitle: The importance of standardization for risk management on Seveso site
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The main element to keep risk in Seveso sites at the acceptable level are internal and external inspection of safety management systems — SMS. Only inspection with clear and standardized criteria can give valid results. The paper is exposed API method for inspection on Seveso SMS as well as its implementation of SMS inspections on Seveso site in Serbia. Based on the research, it was concluded that the standardized inspection process through monitoring and evaluation of risk management is the only right way to keep risk in Seveso sites at an acceptable level.

articleTitle: Mathematical and economic extrapolations on the model for optimal microgrid operation and its solution
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Mixed-integer linear programming problems represent a large group of models that are widely constructed for optimization problems in Electric Power Systems Operation. An economical and financial analysis is obligatory for the obtained solution as being a part of the effective system planning and operation. In this paper a formal approach to such analysis is given having a combinatorial problem with binary variables designing the different states in the microgrid. The numerical example includes a detailed post-solution analysis made with Matlab® and LPSolve.

articleTitle: Modelling PV panels: Case study of Oryahovo, Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper deals with the modeling of small photovoltaic (PV) system output power. The system operator needs information for the expected energy yield of the system to preserve the balance in the grid. Thus, the estimation of this energy yield has a significant role. The present study is based on Durisch's model. In order to optimize the power output prediction of the studied aSi thin film, PV modules were tested with different approaches and empirical parameters. The results were compared with the measured power output at the meteorological conditions of the site of Oryahovo, Bulgaria. It is observed that the model is suitable for prediction of the power output under different conditions and can be used for bigger PV plant or for building integrated photovoltaic system with aSi thin film modules.

articleTitle: Criteria at selection of method for job implementation evaluation in high-tech enterprises
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The effectiveness and efficiency evaluation of hightech enterprises is directly connected with the degree of produced goods and offered services innovation. On its part, in the upmost degree, this is what directly depends on the human capital of a high-tech enterprise. Reasonably question emerged about job implementation evaluation in order to reach the company goals. On the other side, the most responsible for reaching the goals of high-tech enterprises positions are characterised with requirement for a high level of workcreativity. In this paper the authors analyse some of the basic points of view concerning evaluation of task achievements and they propose criteria to choose a method for their assessment in conditions of high-tech enterprises. In this paper are exposed on analysis different method about evaluation of job implementation. Defined their relevance from point of view of creative professions implemented in high - technological enterprises. Hera are proposed criteria and consequently of steps for choice of method for evaluation of job implementation.

articleTitle: Light electronic regulator based on open-source microcontroller platform
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This article describes an electronic ambient light controller, based on the open microprocessor system Arduino ProMini. Structural schemes and ways of operation of control systems are presented. Results from computer simulation and experimental studies have been brought out. The main purpose is to reach a minimum time of the transient process within the initial turn on and regulation of the system.

articleTitle: The choice of optimal system composed of linear conductors for electrostatic space protection
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: System of integral equations for the electric scalar potential (integral equations Rabin's type), for the observed electrostatic model composed of linear conductors, can be formed. Since this equation cannot be solved correct analytically, a very simple and convenient accurate point matching method, with a polynomial approximation of functions of longitudinal charge density of conductors, has been used. A new numerical procedure for optimization of the system used for electrostatic protection of space is developed in this paper. The optimization of formed functional, consists of electrostatic energy density and system of linear equations witch follows from the equipotential character of the system of conductors, is used for the protection. By minimizing this functional, the system of nonlinear equation is obtained and then numerically solved. The energy density is defined in the points along the axis of the system. A few numerical examples are given.

articleTitle: Output characteristics analysis of gensets for modeling of an expert system for fault detection purposes
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In complex systems, such as military organizations, a large number of technical resources requiring regular maintenance is used. These resources are often exposed to difficult working conditions increasing the probability of a fault occurrence. Fault diagnosis as a part of the maintenance process is often a complex process, which is why expert systems for fault diagnosis are developed. One of the possible systems developed for fault diagnosis on gensets uses the Bayesian network to decide on a fault with the highest probability. For proper system operation, it is important to have a reliable “knowledge base” encompassing results of diagnostic tests. Apart from direct measurements, simulation results are also used in order to obtain diagnostic results. Fault simulations are performed on a model developed using the Matlab Simulink program package.

articleTitle: Problems and trends in training of electrical engineers
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Preparation of highly qualified electrical engineers is a key issue for the country's economy. Building specialists like these is directly related to the secondary education problems, unclear vision of university education and business. Based on the analysis of some of the most significant problems, a number of comparisons and analyses have been made with regard to the impact of some of the most important factors on the educational process of training electrical engineers in Bulgaria. Specific measures are suggested to address some of the issues related to training, funding and stabilizing the engineering education.

articleTitle: Evaluation and different control methods of the transformer noise (Literature survey)
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The importance and recent achievements in the field of noise control of power transformer are expounded in this paper. Oscillation is presented as the reason for the transformer and cooling system noise. The methods used in transformer noise research are summed up. The measures for controlling the transformer noise are introduced in detail. High-quality silicon-steel is suggested to be used, as well as adopting some effective measures when design, machining and install transformers. Assuasive equipments, muffler, sound insulation board and isolation booth, which will result attenuation in noise transmission, are proposed in order to reducing noise. As an important power transfer station, the transformer substation is also the main noise source in power transmission project. It will inevitably affect the station staff, nearby residents, and the local environment. Therefore, the research on substation noise control methods is particularly important. Transformers located near a residential area should have sound level as low as possible. The design and the manufacture of a transformer with low sound level require in-depth analysis of noise sources.

articleTitle: High voltage transmission line stringing operation. Usage of unmanned aerial vehicles for installation of conductor and grounding wires with optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The topic of this article, except of description of general issues concerning stringing, is also choice between two aerial method of unrolling initial rope, taking into account various technical, financial, and locational aspects as well as availability of offers on the market, which might help determine the most suitable and appropriate solution. Additionally, the following work focuses on limitations and advantages, as well as considerations based on exemplary section from real, currently under construction high voltage 400 kV line Ostroleka-Olsztyn Matki, which deadline is set in the beginning of January 2016. Usage of exemplary section enables to perform more thorough financial comparison between utilization of drone or helicopter, as well as expedites assessment process between both aircrafts, in the context of transmission line construction.

articleTitle: Comparison of the conductors' mechanical mode calculations using different mathematical models
publicationTitle: 2017 15th International Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper analyzes sag-tension characteristics for various designs of high temperature low sag conductors. The differences that occur in the results for the estimated sag when using parabolic and catenary dependences are analyzed. The presented study cases are for two different span lengths −250 and 350m. The inclination between the attachment points is also taken in consideration. The influence of the catenary constant on the sag estimation errors is analyzed. The conclusions are that the adequate and accurate sag-tension calculations are crucial for the secure operation of power lines.
